title: 暴走公路
problem_statement_md:
假设你需要一次公路暴走之旅。你的平均速度是每小时**40**公里。

输入你需要暴走的里程公里数（代码已经存在），向控制台输出你走完所需的时间，单位为**分钟**。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Trip Planner[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You need to plan a road trip. You are traveling at an average speed of [b]40 miles an hour[/b]. 
Given a distance in miles as input (the code to take input is already present), output to the console the time it will take you to cover it [b]in minutes[/b].

[b]Sample Input:[/b]
150

[b]Sample Output:[/b]
225
[note][b]Explanation[/b]: It will take 150/40 = 3.75 hours to cover the distance, which is equivalent to 3.75*60 = [b]225[/b] minutes. [/note]
